gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-slabo-13px: Luxurious spacing opens Stentiga up, its letters stretched out with crossbars as heavy as the stems. Slabo 13px follows in a text serif that feels bookish and dignified, with large open shapes that keep paragraphs of it easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-stentiga-inter: Refined and spread out, Stentiga lets its crossbars and wide openings do the showing off. And Inter, a plain sans with hollow-feeling counters and smooth lines, handles the quiet job of carrying the words.
gen-dafont-stentiga-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab brings a precise, structured texture, with open throats on its a, c, e and s. Stentiga's rounded-nib letters, stretched wide and without swelling at the stroke ends, feel softer and more luxurious beside that slab-serif firmness.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-asap: Stocky, bold, and refusing to close its curves: that is True North. It is built to grab attention, while Asap, a plain sans with open arcs and a body height close to the capitals, is built to be read.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-epilogue: True North sits stocky and bold, its tall middle band leaving curves that never quite shut. But Epilogue's wire-thin monoline sans, curvy and approachable, is the real surprise, hollow like glass tubing against that heavy heading.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-merriweather-sa: Curves that refuse to close give True North its stocky, restless look. Merriweather Sans answers with sturdy, large-looking words, and its sans e opens clearly to the right, which makes the pair feel grounded and bold together.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-supreme: Contemporary and stocky, True North leans on a tall middle band and curves left open. Supreme sets a crisp, heavy-looking strip of sans text beneath it, letters held open rather than curled shut, so both layers feel solid and confident.
gen-dafont-true-north-general-sans: Chunky, open-curved, unmistakably bold: that is True North. General Sans takes the opposite job, a clean sans with flat, contrast-free letters and a tall x-height that keeps each line smooth, where the heading only needs to make an entrance.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, Fauna One keeps a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders. Fauna One against True North makes the pair's strongest quality plain: a bold, stocky heading that meets a text serif with a gentler, bookish voice.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings editorial refinement, with big counters and curves whose mouths stay wide and unclosed. Glegoo is a classic serif that could sit nicely a little larger than usual under True North's stocky, bold heading.
